title: For the Misgendered Chinese in Gender Bias Research: Multi-Task Learning with Knowledge Distillation for Pinyin Name-Gender Prediction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the accuracy and directional bias of name-based gender prediction models using the 'errorGenderBias' metric to assess whether misclassifications are more frequent for male or female names.

Comparing gender classification error rates of commercial tools across names of different origins (e.g., European, African, and Chinese) to demonstrate performance disparities and the resulting systemic misgendering or exclusion of Chinese individuals.
